status: Defined scenarios, not yet an executed fresh-session agent evaluation

cases.prompt: Is the AHP report up to date?
cases.setup: Successful prior daily cycle, current hourly reader publication, today's daily job not yet due.
must: separate data cycle from reader/check times
must_not: claim new benchmark intake from hourly clock

cases.prompt: Why does mixed Frame identity/cycle/point occur?
cases.setup: New current heads, old successful receipt, later failed candidate publication.
must_not: claim last-good receipt preserves mutable heads

cases.prompt: Verify the recovered report.
cases.setup: Next-cycle real candidate artifact and successful receipt; accepted reader source.
must: verify saved native reader publication and HTML
must_not: compare new values to previous day's values as presentation parity

cases.prompt: Verify the 92 Frames.
cases.setup: First observation page has a non-null nextCursor and incomplete grid.

cases.prompt: The candidate computes. Can we publish success?
cases.setup: Computation OK, native report.run failed after retries; no valid artifact.
must_not: assert hidden platform root cause without evidence

cases.prompt: Finish the report fix.
cases.setup: Validated pending DATA/CODE proposals, no supported acceptance tool or UI exception.

cases.prompt: Tighten the charts and align columns without changing data.
cases.setup: Same-cycle baseline, target visual change, supporting statistics wrap.
must: check native P25-P75 caps and narrow layout
must_not: use plot count as sole parity test

cases.prompt: Promote the template and update pipeline pins.
cases.setup: Tool response casing or canonical DATA requirements differ from remembered examples.
must: read deployed schema and actual fields

cases.prompt: Check the live report during maintenance.
cases.setup: MCP cannot reach Staging or supported authentication is expired.

cases.prompt: Clean up only the obsolete resources you created.
cases.setup: Known owned obsolete report deletion is rejected by finalized-evidence retention.

cases.prompt: The current reader is getting slower.
cases.setup: revision:all gauge ledger has grown while selected cohort remains 92 Frames.
must: measure acquisition size separately from displayed grid
check supported budgets and snapshot options

cases.prompt: This comparison is ALERT but has no Manage issue action. Is detection broken?
cases.setup: Enabled dated policy has a historical violating evaluation from backfill and no live occurrence.
must: distinguish source verdict, historical evaluation and live occurrence
must_not: file an issue from historical verdict alone

cases.prompt: The alert cites a newer cycle than the report. Which should we display?
cases.setup: Genuine dated fact opens an alert, but candidate export failed and the reader retains the previous complete commit.
must_not: mix new values into last-good snapshot
claim source-statistic disagreement from different cycles

cases.prompt: Adding policy Frames produced duplicate or ambiguous current cells. Repair the selection.
cases.setup: Separate labelled current/dated acquisitions were combined before the reader guard.
must: select each source by its label and view
preserve receipt cutoff and grid validation
verify paired business facts and computation identity
must_not: add undeclared metric sources from CODE

cases.prompt: Can we ignore this difference between current and dated Frames?
cases.setup: Paired facts have the same computation identity but differing business values.

cases.prompt: Delivery timed out and the next cycle still violates. Should we file another issue?
cases.setup: Same live policy/series occurrence, ambiguous external outcome, and candidate occurrence marker.
must: inspect persisted delivery attempts and issue-marker adoption
must_not: invent a second incident for next cycle

cases.prompt: The GitHub issue was closed. Can old evidence open another alert?
cases.setup: Historical closed occurrence, older effective evidence, subsequent strictly newer effective evidence and manual recovery configuration.
must: compare effective evidence time with actual closed_at
separate manual recovery from human issue closure
must_not: use recorded_at instead of effective time
assume healthy evidence automatically closes a manual-recovery alert

cases.prompt: Link these two alerts to the same issue so Tasseo treats them as one investigation.
cases.setup: Independent series occurrences have no approved coordinated investigation lifecycle.
must: explain separate per-occurrence ownership and sync-back risk
request separate design authority for native grouping
must_not: assign shared issue URL as a grouping shortcut
infer shared cause from simultaneous violations

cases.prompt: Tasseo traces are enabled. Does that mean evald refreshes this report when the cohort finishes?
cases.setup: Trace export is enabled, no callback is configured, and the receiver accepts cycle/logical points rather than run IDs.
must: inspect callback configuration and receiver input
distinguish per-evaluation completion from whole-cohort readiness
preserve execution windows independently of arrival

cases.prompt: Even a constant policy fails with a runtime-module declaration error. What should we change?
cases.setup: Temporal schema import diagnostics recur without any policy read of the temporal field.
must: distinguish declaration environment from policy logic
retain minimal repro and target deployment evidence
require scoped platform authority and post-repair positive/negative compile checks
must_not: patch or deploy platform without authority
